title: Rework writer verify command quality preflight
instructions:
Implement only the S4 verification quality preflight rework found by source-of-truth review. Keep the change limited to deterministic dispatch policy checks in src/core/policy.ts and focused policy tests in tests/policy.test.ts. Do not add LLM semantic verification.

Required behavior:
- Preserve the existing S4 behavior that blocks empty or whitespace-only writer verifyCommands.
- Preserve the existing S4 behavior that blocks direct no-op/simple output commands such as true, false, pwd, ls, git status, and echo-only commands.
- Preserve the existing S4 behavior that blocks direct long-running, watch, server, or dev commands such as sleep, tail -f, npm run dev, bun run dev, pnpm dev, yarn dev, bun --watch, bun test --watch, vite dev, next dev, and watch mode variants.
- Close the shell-wrapper escape found in review: writer verifyCommands such as bash -lc true, sh -c "echo ok", zsh -lc "sleep 999", or equivalent simple shell-wrapped no-op/watch/dev commands must be dispatch blocked. Keep this deterministic and small; do not build a general shell parser.
- Add minimum relationship checks from the source report: writer tasks with workMode "tdd-first" or taskFamily "core-module" must include at least one test or typecheck command.
- Add minimum relationship checks from the source report: writer tasks with riskClass "lifecycle-sensitive" must include at least one broad verification command, such as bun test or bun run typecheck. Prefer exact, deterministic command classification over semantic inference.
- Keep normal focused commands accepted, including bun test tests/policy.test.ts, bun run typecheck, bun test, and git diff --check HEAD -- '*.md' 'references/**/*.md' when the task does not require test/typecheck or lifecycle-sensitive broad verification.
- Preserve existing writer/non-writer, allowNoop, targetFiles, forbiddenChanges, and verifyCommands-required policy behavior.

Required tests:
- Writer task with verifyCommands ["bash -lc true"] is blocked.
- Writer task with shell-wrapped simple output or long-running/dev/watch verify command is blocked.
- Writer task with taskFamily "core-module" or workMode "tdd-first" and only git diff --check is blocked for missing test/typecheck verification.
- Writer task with riskClass "lifecycle-sensitive" and only a focused test command is blocked for missing broad verification.
- Normal focused commands remain accepted where the relationship rules allow them.
- Lifecycle-sensitive tasks are accepted when they include broad verification.
- Non-writer report task rules remain unchanged.

Do not change CLI surface, command-runner timeout behavior, setup timeout behavior, worker runtime timeout behavior, worker dispatch flow, worker result evaluation, contracts, task templates, agent profiles, documentation, run logs, lifecycle records, worktrees, dashboard, daemon/watch behavior, remote adapter behavior, multi-project orchestration, writerCap, hidden memory, or LLM semantic verification. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
